name: Question 6
worked_solution:
First, we simplify the expression by distributing the subtraction over the matrices in the parentheses:

$$
\begin{aligned}G+H-(H+F) & =G+H-H-F \\  & =G+\cancel{H}-\cancel{H}-F \\  & =G-F\end{aligned}
$$

We are left with a single subtraction. So, we subtract the corresponding entries of the two matrices:

$$
\begin{aligned}G-F & =[\begin{aligned}5 & 4 & -5 \\ 1 & -2 & 2\end{aligned}]-[\begin{aligned}2 & -1 & 2 \\ 3 & 4 & 1\end{aligned}] \\  & =[\begin{aligned}5-2 & 4-(-1) & -5-2 \\ 1-3 & -2-4 & 2-1\end{aligned}] \\  & =[\begin{aligned}3 & 5 & -7 \\ -2 & -6 & 1\end{aligned}]\end{aligned}
$$

Question 6
?

Find G+H−(H+F), if

F=[2−12341],G=[54−51−22],H=[13−25−14].

a
[53−7−6−21]
b
[35−7−463]
c
[7374−23]
d
[−2−6135−7]
e
[35−7−2−61]
Submit
Correct
EXPLANATION

First, we simplify the expression by distributing the subtraction over the matrices in the parentheses: G+H−(H+F)=G+H−H−F=G+H−H−F=G−F

We are left with a single subtraction. So, we subtract the corresponding entries of the two matrices:

G−F=[54−51−22]−[2−12341]=[5−24−(−1)−5−21−3−2−42−1]=[35−7−2−61]
